dialogues.jp:
ぶ〜らぶら、と足が地面を踏みしめ、小さな手
に繋がれた腕が揺れている。
dialogues.en:
I stroll along, holding Sakura's small hand and swinging her
arm.
dialogues.text:
I stroll along, holding Sakura's small hand and swinging her
arm.

dialogues.jp: 「どこで飯にするか」
dialogues.en: "Where do you wanna eat?"
dialogues.text: "Where do you wanna eat?"

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp:
「どこでもいいよ。辛い物じゃなきゃ、お肉と
　かがいいな。ピーマンは嫌いだけど」
dialogues.en:
"I don't care. I just don't like spicy food. Um... I feel
like eating meat, but I hate green peppers, though."
dialogues.text:
"I don't care. I just don't like spicy food. Um... I feel
like eating meat, but I hate green peppers, though."

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp:
「あ、でも人が多いところじゃないほうがいい
　な。でも雰囲気があるところじゃなきゃダメ
　だよ？」
dialogues.en:
"Oh, I like areas that aren't crowded, but it has to have a
certain atmosphere."
dialogues.text:
"Oh, I like areas that aren't crowded, but it has to have a
certain atmosphere."

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp:
「手前、それは注文の多いレストランとかけた、
　婉曲な俺への嫌がらせか？」
dialogues.en:
"It sounds to me like you're adding all these conditions
just to make it hard for me. Right?"
dialogues.text:
"It sounds to me like you're adding all these conditions
just to make it hard for me. Right?"

dialogues.jp:
さくらの頭に空いている手をのせて、いつでも
握り締められるようにした。
dialogues.en:
I put my other hand on Sakura's head so that I can squeeze
her any time I like.
dialogues.text:
I put my other hand on Sakura's head so that I can squeeze
her any time I like.

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp:
「うにゃら〜。最終的にボクは、お兄ちゃんと
　一緒ならどこでもいいんだけどね♪」
dialogues.en:
"Hmm... Basically, I don't care where we eat as long as I'm
with you, oniichan."
dialogues.text:
"Hmm... Basically, I don't care where we eat as long as I'm
with you, oniichan."

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「かったる」
dialogues.en: "What a pain in the neck."
dialogues.text: "What a pain in the neck."

dialogues.jp:
俺がなんのために手をのせたのかも勘違いして
笑っていやがるし。
dialogues.en:
She's also laughing without knowing the real reason why I
put my other hand on her head.
dialogues.text:
She's also laughing without knowing the real reason why I
put my other hand on her head.

dialogues.jp: 「じゃ、あそこにするか」
dialogues.en: "Okay, let's go there."
dialogues.text: "Okay, let's go there."

dialogues.jp: 俺は、少し先にある茶屋を指差す。
dialogues.en: I point to the cafe that we're about to pass.
dialogues.text: I point to the cafe that we're about to pass.

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「出会い茶屋？」
dialogues.en: "Is that a meet-up cafeteria?"
dialogues.text: "Is that a meet-up cafeteria?"

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp:
「……お前、いっぺん脳みそシェイクしたろ
　か？」
dialogues.en: "...Hey, why don't you shake your brain for once?"
dialogues.text: "...Hey, why don't you shake your brain for once?"

dialogues.jp:
ちなみに、出会い茶屋とは昔の逢引きの場所。
今でいう――まぁ、そういう場所のことだ。
dialogues.en:
To explain, a 'meet-up cafeteria' used to be a place for
secret dating, a long time ago. In other words, it's a love
hotel.
dialogues.text:
To explain, a 'meet-up cafeteria' used to be a place for
secret dating, a long time ago. In other words, it's a love
hotel.

dialogues.jp: さくらと時代劇を見ていての知識なんだが……。
dialogues.en:
I learned that from samurai movies that I watched with
Sakura.
dialogues.text:
I learned that from samurai movies that I watched with
Sakura.

dialogues.jp: 「花より団子という、れっきとした食事処だ」
dialogues.en:
"The name of the cafe is 'Bread is Better than Birdsong'.
It's a highly respectable restaurant."
dialogues.text:
"The name of the cafe is 'Bread is Better than Birdsong'.
It's a highly respectable restaurant."

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「お兄ちゃんの好きそうなネーミングだね」
dialogues.en: "I know you like the name, don't you?"
dialogues.text: "I know you like the name, don't you?"

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「ほっとけ」
dialogues.en: "Leave me alone."
dialogues.text: "Leave me alone."

dialogues.jp:
俺はさくらの手をひいたまま、店ののれんをく
ぐった。
dialogues.en: I duck under the shop curtain, pulling Sakura's hand.
dialogues.text: I duck under the shop curtain, pulling Sakura's hand.

dialogues.speaker: Attendant
dialogues.jp: 「いらっしゃいませ〜」
dialogues.en: "Hello, welcome!"
dialogues.text: "Hello, welcome!"

dialogues.jp:
バイトであろう、俺達とそう年齢の変わらない
少女が笑顔を振り撒く。
dialogues.en: A part-time waitress about our age greets us with a smile.
dialogues.text: A part-time waitress about our age greets us with a smile.

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「いらっしゃいました〜♪」
dialogues.en: "Thank you, we feel welcome!"
dialogues.text: "Thank you, we feel welcome!"

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「お前はだまっとれ」
dialogues.en: "Be quiet."
dialogues.text: "Be quiet."

dialogues.jp: ぐぎ。
dialogues.en: Mmm.
dialogues.text: Mmm.

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「うにゃば――！？」
首をしめて黙らせる。
dialogues.en: I get her to shut up by choking her neck.
dialogues.text: I get her to shut up by choking her neck.

dialogues.jp:
「なんだか最近、さくらの扱いに慣れてきた気
　がするなぁ」
dialogues.en: "I know how to deal with you now."
dialogues.text: "I know how to deal with you now."

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「ぼ、暴力反対……」
dialogues.en: "Against violence..."
dialogues.text: "Against violence..."

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「お前が言うなよ」
dialogues.en: "You can't talk."
dialogues.text: "You can't talk."

dialogues.speaker: Attendant
dialogues.jp: 「あの……お客様」
dialogues.en: "Excuse me... sir?"
dialogues.text: "Excuse me... sir?"

dialogues.speaker: Attendant
dialogues.jp: 「あぁ、はい」
dialogues.en: "Ye-yes."
dialogues.text: "Ye-yes."

dialogues.jp: プロ根性で笑みを保つ店員さんに笑いかける。
dialogues.en:
I give a smile to the waitress, who is still maintaining a
professional smile.
dialogues.text:
I give a smile to the waitress, who is still maintaining a
professional smile.

dialogues.speaker: Attendant
dialogues.jp: 「中でのお食事が宜しいですか？」
dialogues.en: "Would you prefer to eat inside?"
dialogues.text: "Would you prefer to eat inside?"

dialogues.speaker: Attendant
dialogues.jp: 「いや、外で食べます」
dialogues.en: "No, I prefer eating outside."
dialogues.text: "No, I prefer eating outside."

dialogues.jp:
せっかく天気もいいんだし、こういう時には外
に設えられた椅子で食ったほうが気分もいい。
dialogues.en: It's better to eat outdoors in this nice weather.
dialogues.text: It's better to eat outdoors in this nice weather.

dialogues.speaker: Attendant
dialogues.jp:
「分かりました。今日はお客さんも少ないので、
　お好きな席をお使いください」
dialogues.en:
"That's fine. You can sit anywhere you want since we don't
have many customers today."
dialogues.text:
"That's fine. You can sit anywhere you want since we don't
have many customers today."

dialogues.speaker: Attendant
dialogues.jp:
「今、お茶をお持ちしますので、少々お待ちく
　ださいな」
dialogues.en: "I'll bring some tea right away."
dialogues.text: "I'll bring some tea right away."

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.en: "Sure!"
dialogues.text: "Sure!"

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「黙ってメニューを見ろっての」
dialogues.en: "Just look at the menu without saying anything."
dialogues.text: "Just look at the menu without saying anything."

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「メニューじゃないよ、お品書きだよ」
dialogues.en: "It's not a menu, it's a list of dishes."
dialogues.text: "It's not a menu, it's a list of dishes."

dialogues.jp:
ひょい、と手近な席に腰掛けて、さくらがお品
書きに手を伸ばす。
dialogues.en: Sitting in a nearby chair, Sakura grabs the list of dishes.
dialogues.text: Sitting in a nearby chair, Sakura grabs the list of dishes.

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「……ピーマンはない」
dialogues.en: "They don't have green peppers."
dialogues.text: "They don't have green peppers."

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「ないって」
dialogues.en: "No, they don't."
dialogues.text: "No, they don't."

dialogues.jp: 苦笑いを浮かべて俺も椅子に座る。
dialogues.en: I sit down on a chair smiling wryly.
dialogues.text: I sit down on a chair smiling wryly.

dialogues.en: "Whew..."
dialogues.text: "Whew..."

dialogues.jp:
天気もいいし、静かな茶屋で日向ぼっこという
のも悪くない。
dialogues.en:
It's not a bad idea to spend time at a cafe in the sun in
such a nice weather.
dialogues.text:
It's not a bad idea to spend time at a cafe in the sun in
such a nice weather.

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「う〜ん、ビバ和風♪」
dialogues.en: "Uhh, Viva Japanese!"
dialogues.text: "Uhh, Viva Japanese!"

dialogues.jp: さくらもご満悦のようだし。
dialogues.en: Sakura looks happy, too.
dialogues.text: Sakura looks happy, too.

dialogues.jp: 「お勧めは桜餅と桜茶だぞ」
dialogues.en: "I recommend the cherry rice cake and the cherry tea."
dialogues.text: "I recommend the cherry rice cake and the cherry tea."

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「なにそれ！？」
dialogues.en: "What are those?!"
dialogues.text: "What are those?!"

dialogues.jp: ばっ、とお品書きから顔を上げる。
dialogues.en: She lifts her head from the list of dishes.
dialogues.text: She lifts her head from the list of dishes.

dialogues.jp: なにを驚いているのか。
dialogues.en: I don't know why she's so surprised.
dialogues.text: I don't know why she's so surprised.

dialogues.jp: 「いや、普通に桜の花を使った餅とお茶だけど」
dialogues.en:
"It's just a rice cake and tea made from cherry blossom
petals."
dialogues.text:
"It's just a rice cake and tea made from cherry blossom
petals."

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.en: "What?"
dialogues.text: "What?"

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp:
「あの味だけは俺にも作れないからな。桜の花
　単体の味をうまく理解できないからだろうけ
　ど」
dialogues.en:
"I can't produce that taste myself. It's hard to get down to
the real taste of cherryblossoms."
dialogues.text:
"I can't produce that taste myself. It's hard to get down to
the real taste of cherryblossoms."

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp:
「うにゃ……もしかしてその料理、この島の桜
　の花びらを使ってるの？」
dialogues.en:
"Hmm... Do they use the cherry blossom petals from this
island to make this dish?"
dialogues.text:
"Hmm... Do they use the cherry blossom petals from this
island to make this dish?"

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp:
「あ、そうじゃないの？　わざわざ桜の花を輸
　入するやつもいないだろう」
dialogues.en:
"I think so. Who'd import cherry blossom petals from
somewhere else?"
dialogues.text:
"I think so. Who'd import cherry blossom petals from
somewhere else?"

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「うわっ……アンビリバボー」
dialogues.en: "Whoa, unbelievable!"
dialogues.text: "Whoa, unbelievable!"

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「なんだよ一体？」
dialogues.en: "What is it?"
dialogues.text: "What is it?"

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「どうしよっかどうしよっか……考え中」
dialogues.en: "I don't know what to order...... still thinking..."
dialogues.text: "I don't know what to order...... still thinking..."

dialogues.jp: 目線を逸らしてさくらが口元に手を当てる。
dialogues.en: Sakura puts her hand over her mouth looking at the menu.
dialogues.text: Sakura puts her hand over her mouth looking at the menu.

dialogues.jp: 「なんだよ」
dialogues.en: "What?"
dialogues.text: "What?"

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「まぁ……害があるものじゃないし……」
dialogues.en: "Well, it's not a poison..."
dialogues.text: "Well, it's not a poison..."

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「ドント・ウォーリー♪」
dialogues.en: "Don't worry."
dialogues.text: "Don't worry."

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「なんだかなぁ……」
dialogues.en: "What's going on?"
dialogues.text: "What's going on?"

dialogues.jp:
わけが分からないと首をひねっていると、店の
中から店員さんがお茶を持ってやってきた。
dialogues.en:
While I was shaking my head, the waitress brought some tea
for us.
dialogues.text:
While I was shaking my head, the waitress brought some tea
for us.

dialogues.speaker: Attendant
dialogues.jp: 「お客さん、ご注文のほうはお決まりですか？」
dialogues.en: "Are you ready to order?"
dialogues.text: "Are you ready to order?"

dialogues.speaker: Attendant
dialogues.jp: 「あ、はい。俺は桜餅のセット。おいお前は」
dialogues.en: "Yes, I'll have a cherry rice cake combo. How about you?"
dialogues.text: "Yes, I'll have a cherry rice cake combo. How about you?"

dialogues.jp: 肘でさくらをつつく。
dialogues.en: I nudge her with my elbow.
dialogues.text: I nudge her with my elbow.

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp:
「あにゃ〜、まぁ実証に実地試験は必要なもの
　だからね。桜餅のセット」
dialogues.en:
"Well... I need an experiment to prove it. So I'll have a
cherry rice cake combo, too."
dialogues.text:
"Well... I need an experiment to prove it. So I'll have a
cherry rice cake combo, too."

dialogues.jp:
わけの分からないことを呟きつつではあるが、
元気にさくらが答える。
dialogues.en: Sakura answers decisively while muttering gibberish.
dialogues.text: Sakura answers decisively while muttering gibberish.

dialogues.speaker: Attendant
dialogues.jp:
「あ、桜茶はね、お嬢ちゃんにはちょ〜っと渋
　すぎるかも知れないですよ〜」
dialogues.en:
"Um... The cherry tea may be a little bit bitter for you,
young lady."
dialogues.text:
"Um... The cherry tea may be a little bit bitter for you,
young lady."

dialogues.jp: 明らかに子供向けの言葉遣いに場が凍る。
dialogues.en: She broke the mood by talking down to Sakura.
dialogues.text: She broke the mood by talking down to Sakura.

dialogues.speaker: Attendant
dialogues.en: "Oh?"
dialogues.text: "Oh?"

dialogues.jp:
こめかみに指を当てて、店員さんがポンと手を
打つ。
dialogues.en:
The waitress stops to think for a moment, then claps her
hands.
dialogues.text:
The waitress stops to think for a moment, then claps her
hands.

dialogues.speaker: Attendant
dialogues.jp:
「あ、今このセットを注文すると、お子様には
　竹とんぼとかビー玉の玩具がついてくるんで
　す！」
dialogues.en:
"If you order this meal combo today, it comes with a bamboo
dragonfly and a marble!"
dialogues.text:
"If you order this meal combo today, it comes with a bamboo
dragonfly and a marble!"

dialogues.jp:
じゃ〜ん、と店員さんがポケットから玩具をと
りだした。
dialogues.en: The waitress takes out the toys from her pocket.
dialogues.text: The waitress takes out the toys from her pocket.

dialogues.jp:
あぁ、この状態を表す言葉が浮かんだが、先人
達はなんて素晴らしい語学センスをしていたの
だろう。
dialogues.en:
I know how to describe this exact moment. I'm amazed how
sharp our ancestors were about the sense of language.
dialogues.text:
I know how to describe this exact moment. I'm amazed how
sharp our ancestors were about the sense of language.

dialogues.jp: 墓穴に入らずんば墓地を得ず。
dialogues.en: 'You can't sink into your grave until you're dead.'
dialogues.text: 'You can't sink into your grave until you're dead.'

dialogues.jp: ◆茶屋での出来事◆
dialogues.en: ◆The episode at the cafeteria◆
dialogues.text: ◆The episode at the cafeteria◆

dialogues.jp:
さくらと昼飯を食べるために、商店街の一角に
ある茶屋「花より団子」に入る。
dialogues.en:
We ate lunch at the cafe called 'Bread is Better than
Birdsong', located at the corner of the shopping center.
dialogues.text:
We ate lunch at the cafe called 'Bread is Better than
Birdsong', located at the corner of the shopping center.

dialogues.jp:
そこでさくらが、アルバイトの店員さんに子供
と間違われて頬をふくらませるのだった。
dialogues.en:
Sakura got sulky when the waitress treated her like a young
child.
dialogues.text:
Sakura got sulky when the waitress treated her like a young
child.
